messages:
Tara: FYI opened a docs PR to update the model support matrix and add a tiny SDK example for batched embeddings. Two things I noticed in the current card: the 'max sequence' column is out of date for several models, and the embed example doesn't show batching (customers hit rate limits)

Miguel: Thanks — I bumped the runtime last week. Orca-3 variants now support seq_len=8192 for the float16 paths; quantized builds still cap at 4096. We should reflect that. Also need to call out that KV-shard must be enabled for >4096 to avoid OOM on multi-GPU setups.

Kevin: I can update the SDK snippet. Suggest replacing the single-call example with a batch example like this:

```
# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
inputs = ["short text 1", "another piece of text"]
embs = c.embeddings.create(model="orion-3b", input=inputs, batch_size=8)
```
Also add a note about chunking long documents and the `max_input_tokens` helper.

Jess: Quick QA: the benchmarks table currently lists throughput for 'orion-3b-quant' as 1200 tok/s — our latest run shows ~950 tok/s with 8-bit quant on Ampere. Could we change numbers to 'representative ranges' and link to the benchmark gist? Don't hardcode a single number. :eyes:

docs-bot: PR #2894 — lint check failed: docs/link-check — broken link found: https://internal.example.com/old-bench-results. See CI log: https://ci.redwood/example/2894/logs

Tara: I'll fix the link and convert the numbers to ranges. @Miguel can you confirm the KV-shard recommendation wording? I want something short like: "Enable KV-shard for sequences >4096 when using multi-GPU to avoid OOMs."

Miguel: That wording is fine. Add parenthetical: (requires runtime >= 2026.02). Also add: "Quantized variants may increase decoding latency ~8–12% depending on hardware."

Kevin: I'll push the batch example and a tiny helper snippet for chunking to the examples repo. Will also include a small test in examples/tests/test_embeddings_batch.py. Commands:

```
# from repo root
git checkout -b docs/embeds-batch
git add examples/embeddings_batch.py examples/tests/test_embeddings_batch.py
git commit -m "examples: batch embeddings + test"
git push origin docs/embeds-batch
```

Jess: One more ask — for Dedicated customers we should add a migration note under 'limits' that increasing max_sequence may affect autoscaling/cardinality and instance sizing. Keep it short, link to the Dedicated capacity sizing guide.

Tara: Good call. I'll add a one-liner under the limits section and replace the broken CI link with the public gist. After I push fixes I'll tag @Kevin and @Jess for final review. Thanks everyone :pray:

Kevin: LGTM — ping me when examples repo PR is up, can run the test matrix locally.

Miguel: I'll add a runtime compatibility note to the model card (bottom of the compatibility table) so customers see the runtime cutoff.

Tara: PR updated: replaced hard numbers with ranges, fixed link, added batch example and migration one-liner. Tagging reviewers in the PR description. End-to-end checklist:
- update support matrix rows (seq_len/quant cap)
- add batch embedding SDK snippet
- change benchmark numbers to ranges + gist link
- add KV-shard and runtime cutoff notes
- add Dedicated migration one-liner

Tara: cc @docs-bot for pipeline run.

docs-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #2894 — docs/link-check fixed, examples tests queued. :white_check_mark:
